name: Todoroki Kuon
source:
Element: Fluorine
Rank: 純壱位
Hobby/Skill: Alcohol

The self-proclaimed "Perfect Shikenkan." A self-confident person, but has sufficiently matched ability. He has an attractive appearance and many fans. A person full of joy, anger, sadness, and humor who engages in excessive skinship, expresses his emotions in a straightforward manner, and is always noisy, but is actually a lonely person.
